versos.texto_bv: Agora, faça uma aposta, por favor, com meu senhor, o rei da Assíria: eu lhe darei dois mil cavalos, se você puder fornecer cavaleiros para eles.
versos.traducao_literal: E agora, comprometa-se, por favor, com meu senhor, o rei da Assíria, e darei a você dois mil cavalos, se puder dar para você cavaleiros sobre eles.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0031): A expressão "faça uma aposta" não corresponde ao hebraico התערב (hit’arev), que significa "dar refém/penhor, tornar-se fiador"; o contexto é um desafio irônico de Rabsaqué, não uma aposta literal. A KJV verte "give pledges". A glosa "aposta" desloca o sentido de "dar garantia/refém" para "fazer uma aposta", o que muda a ação descrita. — evidência: Hebraico: התערב נא אדני את מלך אשור (hit’arev na adoni et-melekh Ashshur); KJV: "give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria"; A BV atual emprega "aposta", criando leitura anacrônica.

kjv.texto: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

vizinhos.22: But if ye say unto me, We trust in the Lord our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?
vizinhos.24: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

web.texto: Now therefore, please give pledges to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

vizinhos.22: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in Yahweh our God;’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?’
vizinhos.24: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
